arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat
echo LEADS_STAGE_PR46_BEGIN
root=/opt/telegram-robot-leads
expected=9596a0687aeed20e03bcd1f91ae2ad6d830cd523
installed=$(sudo -n cat "$root/.verified-source-commit" | tr -d '\r\n')
echo "MARKER_BEFORE=$installed"
test "$installed" = "3d53bf473fc0a37a4d8905f58a5bfff0948b3177"
private_fingerprint() {
 sudo -n /usr/bin/python3 -B - <<'PY'
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
h=hashlib.sha256()
p=Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads/operation-state.json')
if not p.is_file():raise SystemExit('STATE_NOT_FOUND')
h.update(p.read_bytes())
vault=Path('/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads')
sessions=sorted(vault.glob('*.session'))
if len(sessions)!=2:raise SystemExit('SESSION_COUNT_UNEXPECTED')
for s in sessions:
 h.update(s.name.encode('utf-8'))
 h.update(s.read_bytes())
print(h.hexdigest())
PY
}
before=$(private_fingerprint)
work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-leads-stage-pr46.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$work"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$work/repo"
test "$(git -C "$work/repo" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$expected"
cd "$work/repo"
sudo -n -H /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -q
echo PRE_STAGE_OFFLINE_TESTS_PASS
files=(scripts/lead_health.py scripts/leads_operational_report.py scripts/operation_policy.py scripts/organic_growth.py scripts/public_group_discovery.py scripts/member_groups.py scripts/growth_radar.py scripts/activate_project_only.py scripts/project_hygiene.py scripts/safe_runtime.py scripts/telegram-robot-leads-status.sh scripts/deploy_project_only.py)
tar -czf "$work/release.tgz" "${files[@]}"
dry=$(sudo -n /usr/bin/python3 -B "$root/scripts/deploy_project_only.py" --bundle "$work/release.tgz" --commit "$expected" --expected-installed "$installed")
echo "DRY_RUN_RESULT=$dry"
printf '%s' "$dry" | /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import json,sys;assert json.load(sys.stdin)["status"]=="DRY_RUN"'
echo DRY_RUN_CONFIRMED
result=$(sudo -n /usr/bin/python3 -B "$root/scripts/deploy_project_only.py" --bundle "$work/release.tgz" --commit "$expected" --expected-installed "$installed" --apply --confirm-telegram-only)
echo "STAGE_RESULT=$result"
printf '%s' "$result" | /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import json,sys;assert json.load(sys.stdin)["status"]=="STAGED_NOT_ACTIVATED"'
test "$(sudo -n cat "$root/.verified-source-commit" | tr -d '\r\n')" = "$expected"
for rel in "${files[@]}";do
 a=$(sha256sum "$work/repo/$rel" | cut -d ' ' -f1)
 b=$(sudo -n sha256sum "$root/$rel" | cut -d ' ' -f1)
 test "$a" = "$b"
done
echo "STAGED_FILE_HASHES_MATCH=${#files[@]}"
after=$(private_fingerprint)
test "$before" = "$after"
echo STATE_AND_SESSIONS_UNCHANGED_PASS
echo LEADS_STAGE_PR46_PASS
